stories.title: Wiesn: Münchens Oberbürgermeister Krause eröffnet 191. Oktoberfest

en.title: Oktoberfest: Munich's Mayor Krause opens 191st festival
en.summary: A Green Party politician tapped the first barrel at Munich's Oktoberfest for the first time, which supporters characterized as a historic moment.

stories.title: Gegen Abrisspläne von Donald Trump: Protestierende bilden Menschenkette um Kennedy Center

en.title: Against Donald Trump's demolition plans: Protesters form human chain around Kennedy Center
en.summary: Hundreds demonstrated in Washington to preserve the Kennedy Center after the U.S. President proposed demolishing the cultural institution, reportedly because his name cannot appear on its facade.

stories.title: Berlin – Wahl zum Abgeordnetenhaus 2026: Berlin ist unwählbar geworden

en.title: Berlin – 2026 election to state parliament: Berlin has become unelectable
en.summary: Berlin's left and right-wing parties are now primarily offering protection from change rather than the freedom and progress the city once represented.

stories.title: Bayern gegen Union: Eine Therapieeinheit in Sachen Treffsicherheit

en.title: Bayern vs Union: A lesson in marksmanship
en.summary: Bayern Munich defeated Union Berlin with goals from Kane, Olise, and new signing Saibari, with the striker receiving a special Oktoberfest gift.

stories.title: USA-Newsblog: Hunderte demonstrieren gegen Kennedy-Center-Pläne Trumps – Foto zeigt ihn mit Abrissplänen

en.title: USA Newsblog: Hundreds demonstrate against Trump's Kennedy Center plans – Photo shows him with demolition plans
en.summary: Hundreds of people protested on Friday against the immediate closure of the Kennedy Center ordered by the U.S. president, who wants to rename the facility after himself.

stories.title: Todesstrafen im Iran: Mann im Iran wegen angeblicher Spionage für Israel hingerichtet

en.title: Death sentences in Iran: Man in Iran executed on suspicion of spying for Israel
en.summary: Iranian authorities executed a man convicted of espionage for Israel, accused of providing the Mossad with information about Iranian missiles.

stories.title: Iran richtet offenbar Mann wegen Spionage hin

en.title: Iran apparently executes man for espionage
en.summary: Iranian authorities executed a man suspected of spying for the Mossad, continuing the regime's use of capital punishment.

stories.title: Viel Kritik und ein wenig Lob für Spritpreis-Entlastungspaket

en.title: Much criticism and some praise for fuel price relief package
en.summary: The German federal government introduced a fuel price relief package combining a tank discount and price cap to address high fuel costs, receiving mostly criticism for imprecision but some support.

stories.title: Fifa: Uefa verlangt von Gianni Infantino 2,1 Milliarden US-Dollar für Mitgliedsverbände

en.title: FIFA: UEFA demands 2.1 billion US dollars from Gianni Infantino for member associations
en.summary: UEFA and Concacaf are requesting that FIFA distribute funds to member associations, citing the organization's substantial reserves of approximately 6 billion dollars accumulated after the World Cup.

stories.title: Liveticker zur Wiesn: Das Oktoberfest ist offiziell eröffnet

en.title: Live coverage of Oktoberfest: The festival is officially opened
en.summary: The 191st Oktoberfest in Munich has officially opened following the traditional barrel tapping by the mayor. The festival grounds are now open to visitors.

stories.title: Sieg gegen Union Berlin: Die Bayern blasen ihre Torflaute fort

en.title: Victory against Union Berlin: Bayern Munich ends its goal drought
en.summary: Bayern Munich defeated Union Berlin 7-0, with striker Harry Kane scoring his 100th Bundesliga goal and midfielder Michael Olise achieving his first hat-trick.

stories.title: Fußball-Bundesliga: FC Bayern München feiert hohen Sieg gegen Union Berlin und Kane-Rekord

en.title: Bundesliga football: FC Bayern Munich celebrates large victory against Union Berlin and Kane record
en.summary: Bayern Munich defeated Union Berlin with Harry Kane breaking a goal-scoring record, though his teammates also delivered spectacular performances.

stories.title: +++ Ukraine-Krieg +++: Putin wirft Ukraine Störung russischer Parlamentswahl vor

en.title: +++ Ukraine War +++: Putin accuses Ukraine of disrupting Russian parliamentary election
en.summary: Poland has concluded its airspace control operations and preemptively scrambled fighter jets. Trump signed a sanctions package against Russia in relation to ongoing developments.

stories.title: Porsche: VW hält bei Porsche weitere 4000 Stellen für entbehrlich

en.title: Porsche: VW considers 4000 additional positions at Porsche as dispensable
en.summary: Porsche's leadership is developing a new strategy focused on producing fewer vehicles. Following a profit warning, executives in Wolfsburg are questioning whether current cost-cutting measures will be sufficient.

stories.title: Insight Innovation: Europas Abschreckung: Wie gut können Frankreichs Atomwaffen Deutschland schützen?

en.title: Insight Innovation: Europe's deterrence: How well can France's nuclear weapons protect Germany?
en.summary: The German military is participating for the first time in France's highly classified nuclear exercise. The report examines France's nuclear deterrence capabilities for Europe and Germany's role in this framework.

stories.title: Kommentar: Die F-35 macht Deutschland militärisch stärker – und politisch abhängiger

en.title: Commentary: The F-35 makes Germany militarily stronger – and politically more dependent
en.summary: Germany's acquisition of F-35 fighter jets advances its military technological capabilities. However, this advancement comes at the cost of increased dependence on the United States under Trump's administration.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Südkorea sagt USA Unterstützung bei Sicherung der Straße von Hormus zu

en.title: +++ Iran War +++: South Korea pledges US support in securing the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Multiple developments reported in regional tensions include Italy escorting a cargo ship through a strait, Pakistan reportedly sending military equipment to Saudi Arabia, and Iran mobilizing volunteers for military activities.
